referenceSourceNote: Lecture 7: Dr Ibrahim Amr, PDF pages 2–19. Bone, muscle and articular geometry: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D via Anatria3D. Original transforms retained. Lunate/fossa surface colors and landmark patches are teaching approximations. New articular meshes show labrum, pelvic/hip/knee/ankle/foot ligaments and menisci in their anatomical positions. Sources used to check visualization are recorded in Sources & model accuracy.
